text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Premium photorealistic wardrobe catalog asset. Portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric and metal texture, subtle contact shadows, whole object uncropped with generous margin. No captions, price labels, watermarks, surroundings or people. Garments: Cream zip track jacket with dark chocolate high stand collar, elastic cuffs and hem, two brown stripes down each sleeve, small embroidered chest emblem; black washed wide-leg denim jeans and burgundy cream low-top sneakers. Show one front-facing assembled outfit using hollow invisible-mannequin display, natural volume but absolutely no body, skin, head, hands, legs, visible mannequin or stand. Exclude ALL detachable accessories: bags, hats, eyeglasses, belts, watches, jewelry and handheld props. Integral garment trims remain. Show hollow inner neck and cuffs.
